content: Those who seek only gold along the mountain stream walk right past the sacred water.
author: Chinese Proverbs
explanation: Obsession with commercial profit narrows human perception down to a tiny, transactional slit. The prospector sifting furiously for gold dust dies of dehydration beside the clearest crystalline spring because his gaze was blinded by the yellow glimmer of rocks.
practicalInsight: Look at the world today without asking, 'What can I get from this?' Appreciate life simply for its intrinsic sacred beauty.
reflectionPrompt: What simple, holy gifts in your daily surroundings are you missing because your eyes are fixated on material gain?
